Data Engineer II

Hyderabad · Hybrid · Full-time

About the role

Hooli's data platform team builds the pipelines that power search quality, ads measurement and product analytics for millions of users. You will join a small team that owns ingestion and modelling for our core event data.

What you'll do

  • Build and operate batch and streaming pipelines on Spark and Flink.
  • Model event data in the warehouse and keep it documented and tested.
  • Partner with analysts and ML engineers on data quality and freshness.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience in data engineering.
  • Strong skills in Python and SQL; Airflow or Dagster experience is a plus.
  • Experience with a cloud data warehouse such as BigQuery or Snowflake.
